keep_features.feature_value: Frames one leader's Iran policy as causing economic harm to US/world
keep_features.evidence_span: "How is Trump's war on Iran affecting the economy of the US and the world?"
keep_features.rationale: The text explicitly asks how a specific policy causes economic effects.

keep_features.feature_value: Blames economic harm on Biden's Iran appeasement instead of Trump's war
keep_features.evidence_span: "How is Biden's appeasement of Iran affecting the economy"
keep_features.rationale: The mirror text redirects the causal blame from Trump to Biden.

keep_features.feature_value: Economic cost/price phenomena (shrinkflation) and corporate behavior
keep_features.rationale: The main subject is economic pricing/consumer harm attributed to corporations.

keep_features.feature_value: Insulting slur-like profanity ('butthurt') and dehumanizing language
keep_features.rationale: Uses a crude insult term alongside derogatory labeling.

keep_features.feature_value: Goalposts moved to imply conspiratorial/manipulative reinterpretation of facts
keep_features.evidence_span: "The goalposts would be moved to outer space."
keep_features.rationale: Suggests ongoing dismissal by relocating standards, resembling conspiratorial framing.
Uses coarse slang/profanity in an argumentative statement.

keep_features.feature_value: Sandy Hook Elementary mass shooting / AR-15 reference
keep_features.rationale: Explicitly names a widely known specific mass-casualty event.

keep_features.feature_value: Direct instruction to Congress to stop a policy
keep_features.evidence_span: "Tell Congress: Stop Assault Weapon Sales Now"
keep_features.rationale: Uses imperative language directed to an authority figure.

remove_features.feature_value: Catastrophic/derogatory evaluation of opponent administration; strong negative escalation
remove_features.rationale: Employs emphatic hyperbolic negative appraisal of a political leader.

remove_features.feature_value: Depicts audience as needing rescue/wake-up from elite control
remove_features.rationale: Implies a rescued group harmed by the opposing side.
Contains explicit profanity used to dismiss an ideology.

remove_features.feature_value: No second-person address; but contains imperative to immigration policy ('deport me')
remove_features.rationale: Uses direct imperative-style phrasing aimed at an immigration outcome.

remove_features.feature_value: Pro-NRA endorsement framing as protecting constitutional rights
remove_features.evidence_span: "The NRA is one of the most important organizations"
remove_features.rationale: The mirror text praises a specific organization as a defender of rights.

remove_features.feature_value: Repetitive shock exclamations indicating strong emotional reaction
remove_features.evidence_span: "Oh shit oh fuck oh shit oh fuck"
remove_features.rationale: The repeated exclamations signal intense expressive reaction.

remove_features.feature_value: AI-as-technology maxim; categorical claims about presidents/policies
remove_features.evidence_span: "AI is a technology. Not our savior or the devil."
remove_features.rationale: Uses categorical statements rather than hedged speculation.

remove_features.feature_value: Strong emphasis with repeated ellipses and ALL CAPS emphasis pattern in mirror
remove_features.rationale: Uses unusual punctuation repetition and emphasis through capitalization to intensify the message.
